title: Personal Checking: savings balances in the same-day maintenance fee waiver review
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when the Relationship Balance waiver is judged for a Personal Checking monthly maintenance fee dated the current business day, the cycle closing date. It states what the owner's PCB savings holdings add to the Relationship Balance compared with the tier's waiver level.

## Formal clause

For this determination, the savings contribution is the current balance of the owner's savings account in each of the statuses applied, active and dormant. The owner's savings balances in these counted statuses are a part of the Relationship Balance compared with the waiver level.

## Status table

| Status of the owner's savings account | Current balance counted? |
|---|---|
| Applied | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Dormant | Yes |
| Any other status | No |

## Worked cases (hypothetical owners)

- An owner holds one active savings account with a current balance of 3200.00 USD. The savings contribution is 3200.00 USD.
- An owner holds one dormant savings account with 450.00 USD and one applied savings account with 0.00 USD. Both statuses count, so the savings contribution is 450.00 USD.
- An owner's only savings account is closed. It is in none of the counted statuses, so the savings contribution is zero.

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "a dormant savings account is left out because it is inactive". **Correct basis:** dormant is one of the counted statuses.
- **Wrong reading:** "the savings account's interest rate or tier changes how much of the balance counts". **Correct basis:** the current balance itself is the figure counted.
